title: libFuzzer coverage-guided fuzzing
preconditions: a deterministic parse entry point exists
steps: Write `extern "C" int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size)` around the parser; never read stdin or files in the harness.
Reject inputs below the minimum size and cap size so one input cannot allocate unbounded memory.
Seed `corpus/` with valid samples and add a dictionary of protocol tokens; run `./fuzz corpus -max_total_time=300 -artifact_prefix=artifacts/`.
Reproduce and triage the first artifact with ASan; use `-minimize_crash=1` to shrink it before analysis.
falsifier: No new coverage after several minutes and no crash; the harness may not reach the parser or instrumentation is missing.
pitfalls: harness reads a file/stdin instead of `data`
